sources.title: AI Model Index
sources.snippet: Search and explore AI models across providers, modalities, and capabilities. Currently supported providers: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, and Mistral AI. See the Model Inclusion Policy for details on selection criteria.

sources.title: JustModels.ai | Create & Train Custom AI Models (No Code)
sources.snippet: Custom AI Model Training Upload 10-20 photos and train a personalized LoRA model in minutes. Your custom model learns the unique features of any person, producing hyper-realistic images and videos with consistent identity across every generation. No coding or machine learning experience needed.

sources.title: Hugging Face - The AI community building the future.
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Introducing the new UR AI Trainer - universal-robots.com
sources.snippet: Introducing the new UR AI Trainer Collect high-fidelity data for industrial on UR's production-grade robots. Integrate with Scale AI's software to capture synchronized motion, force, and vision data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model training.

sources.title: VModel - Deploy and Run AI Models with an API
sources.snippet: VModel simplifies AI deployment with scalable APIs for image generation, text processing, and custom model integration—powering your AI solutions effortlessly.
